The '''snare rifle''' was a cord-shooting weapon designed to ensnare a target so that they can be captured alive.

==Description==
The snare rifle fired a weighted cord that wrapped around the target and ensnared it, stopping it or slowing it down. Although seemingly a primitive weapon, this rifle was useful to a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was operating on a planet with strict weapon laws that banned or restricted his usual arsenal of [[Stun/Legends|stunning]] weapons, such as [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenades]], and [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launchers]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" /> The snare rifle was quite similar to the [[snare gun]] used by slavers. The [[snare pistol]] was a smaller version of the snare rifle.

The snare rifle weighed 5 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and was able to fire 5 shots before needing to be reloaded. The weapon cost 1,200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The specialized replacement cartridges weighed 2 kilograms and cost 50 credits each.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

===Variants===
The [[GRS-1 snare rifle/Legends|GRS-1 snare rifle]] manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions]] was a high-tech variant of the basic snare rifle. Rather than firing a cord, it fired a burst of [[shockstun mist]] incapacitating the target, followed up by a liquid [[Spraynet/Legends|spraynet]] that covered the target, quickly solidifying to hold the target fast. This particular variant was used by [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].
